entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice and a gifted artificer who later founded a school of magic and artifice with Ashnod.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The Chief Artificer whose apprentice was Tawnos.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Tawnos's romantic interest, who gave him the nickname Duck.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war on Dominaria in which Tawnos served Urza.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Brothers' War took place.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Queen of Yotia and a trusted friend of Tawnos.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: An attacker who assaulted Tawnos and Ashnod at Argoth.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whom Tawnos built the Stasis Coffin to imprison.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A weapon Ashnod gave Tawnos, who passed it to Urza.

entities.name: Stasis Coffin
entities.description: A stasis pod built to imprison Mishra, in which Tawnos survived the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Battle at Argoth
entities.description: The final battle of the war, ending in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: The school of magic and artifice founded by Tawnos and Ashnod.

events.summary: Tawnos travels to Kroog and lures Urza from his work with a snake toy, becoming his apprentice.
events.quote: He successfully dragged the Chief Artificer away from his work at the Yotian laboratory by presenting him with a self-made snake toy.

events.summary: After creating clay warrior golems, Tawnos is promoted from apprentice to master.
events.quote: Urza promoted him directly from apprentice to master.

events.summary: At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos while she holds Gix back.
events.quote: They were attacked by Gix , but Ashnod passed the Sylex to Tawnos

events.summary: Tawnos survives the Sylex Blast sealed in the Stasis Coffin and remains there five years until Urza releases him.
events.quote: He remained there for 5 years until the ascended Urza released him.

events.summary: Tawnos helps Kayla defend Penregon against the Church of Tal's siege.
events.quote: helped her to defend the city against the Church of Tal 's Siege of Penregon later that year.

events.summary: Tawnos burns his notes on artifice and disappears from the city.
events.quote: he burned his library of notes on artifice and disappeared from the city

events.summary: Tawnos and Ashnod found the Conclave of Mages near Ronom Lake.
events.quote: By 80 AR, he had reconnected with Ashnod

events.summary: On his deathbed Tawnos writes scraps of parchment about Urza's mightstone and weakstone.
events.quote: On his deathbed some years later, he wrote four scraps of parchment

relations.quote: Tawnos was Urza 's apprentice during the Brothers' War on Dominaria
he developed a romantic interest in Ashnod
Tawnos was also a trusted friend to Yotia's queen
which he had built to imprison Mishra in after the war
